# BRAZ SOUND — Matheus Braz

> Matheus Braz is a Grammy-winning mix and recording engineer based in Los Angeles, working remotely with artists worldwide.

This file describes the public website. Credit roles are specific to the listed work; recording, engineering and assistant credits are not mixing credits. For current published content, use the website.

## Public pages

- [Home, work, studio and contact](https://brazsound.com/)
- [Discography and listening links](https://brazsound.com/discography/)
- [Press and interviews](https://brazsound.com/media/)

## Services

- Professional mixing engineer for pop, R&B, and K-pop.
- Radio-ready mixing with remote collaboration for artists worldwide.
- Recording in Los Angeles and music editing.
